scope: Phase B of the run-engine decided-history connector: the NFL Totals & Run Lines page is a STRUCTURAL 1:1 mirror of MLB's markets page (frontend/markets.py), verified against live screenshots of both pages (data-loaded) in this session plus source-derived structural-parity tests. method.acceptance_bar: any structural difference from MLB not in the documented legitimate-deltas list means the rebuild is NOT done
